comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus seat a swinging ball stud in a tapered knuckle hole.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-rail support, simultaneous two-prong alignment, rear extension and screw driving versus controlling one articulated tie rod and coaxially seating a taper.
comparison.success_condition: Four retained prongs plus correct screws versus one stud within 1 mm axis, 0.5 mm depth and 2 degrees.
comparison.reason: Compliant insertion is shared, but the candidate adds handed orientation, distant dual attachments, telescoping and fastening, constituting a different tested ability. Candidate tolerances are incomplete.
